options.text: Agree and recommend no further assessment.
options.reason: Pain intensity alone cannot determine burn severity.

options.text: Repeatedly scratch the center until pain occurs.
options.reason: This causes additional injury and is not necessary assessment.

options.text: Judge depth only from how loudly the child cries.
options.reason: Behavior is not a reliable single measure of tissue depth.
